top_categories.workout_context: Wild Horse Gravel's private-ranch high desert gravel rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
At mile 60 of 95, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Wild Horse Gravel. Train it until it feels boring.
At Wild Horse Gravel, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Wild Horse Gravel's Book Cliffs high desert, Private-ranch gravel forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 95 miles.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 95 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
When someone attacks on private-ranch high desert gravel, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Wild Horse Gravel's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 95 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
The aerobic base that lets you ride private-ranch high desert gravel at tempo for 95 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
Tempo is Wild Horse Gravel's race pace. The wattage you'll hold for 95 miles on private-ranch high desert gravel. Train it until it's automatic.
Varied gradients on private-ranch high desert gravel demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Wild Horse Gravel’s 95 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at Wild Horse Gravel. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Wild Horse Gravel requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on private-ranch high desert gravel to build confidence. Expect: book cliffs high desert, private-ranch gravel, canyon corridors and mesas.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Durability, and G Spot to prepare you for 95 miles of private-ranch high desert gravel in De Beque, Colorado (High Lonesome Ranch Basecamp).
